The '''Drgi system''' was located in the [[Tokamac sector/Legends|Tokamac sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rorr'hn of Drgi]].<ref name="Galaxy7">{{GalaxyCite|7|Design An Alien}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Drgi [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-13.<ref name="TEA" />
